abstract:
MPC-guided RL for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation

# Training-time MPC Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation Junheng Li · Liang Wu · Sergio A. Esteban · Lizhi Yang · Ján Drgoňa · Aaron D. Ames arXiv:2606.05687 Humanoid locomotion and manipulation RL, guided at training time by a **GPU-batched centroidal model-predictive controller (MPC)**, solved in parallel by **$\pi^n$ MPC**. A centroidal QP-MPC is solved for every environment at the policy rate. Its optimal plan — CoM and momentum trajectory, ground-reaction forces, foot placements, and (for manipulation) hand push forces — is fed into the RL environment to shape the reward and inform the critic. The policy therefore learns to *track an optimal model-based plan* rather than to discover dynamic locomotion and manipulation from scratch. This repository contains only the training environments, the MPC, and the proposed batch MPC solver **$\pi^n$ MPC** in JAX and PyTorch. ## Tasks | Task ID | Description | |---|---| | `Mjlab-MPC-Guided-Locomotion-Themis` | MPC-guided velocity locomotion on flat terrain. | | `Mjlab-MPC-Guided-Loco-manipulation-Themis` | MPC-guided loco-manipulation — walking and pushing a box. | ## Setup Requires Python 3.11–3.13 and a CUDA 12 GPU. This installs everything: `mjlab` (MuJoCo / `mujoco-warp` / PyTorch / `rsl_rl`), `scipy`, and `jax[cuda12]` for the JAX PiMPC solver. ## Training Trained with mjlab's `train` entry point and 4096 parallel environments: Resume from a checkpoint (regex match on the run-directory timestamp; omit `--agent.load-checkpoint` to take the latest): Play back a trained policy: ## MPC & solvers The centroidal MPC lives in [`src/themis_mpc/`](src/themis_mpc/): `CentroidalMPC` (locomotion) and `LocoManipMPC` (adds hand push-force variables). The QP is built over a short horizon from a phase-driven contact schedule and solved **batched across all environments in a single call**, selected per task
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在训练时由GPU批处理质心模型预测控制器（MPC）引导的人形机器人运动与操作强化学习（RL）方法，该控制器由$\pi^n$ MPC并行求解。在每个环境中，以策略频率求解质心QP-MPC，其最优计划——包括质心和动量轨迹、地面反作用力、落脚点以及（对于操作任务）手部推力——被输入到RL环境中，以塑造奖励并为评论家提供信息。因此，策略学习的是跟踪最优模型规划，而非从头发现动态运动与操作。本仓库仅包含训练环境、MPC以及所提出的批处理MPC求解器$\pi^n$ MPC（JAX和PyTorch实现）。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出在训练时用GPU批处理的质心模型预测控制（MPC）为每个环境并行求解最优规划（质心轨迹、动量、地面反作用力、落脚点及手部推力），并将该规划用于奖励塑形和critic指导，使策略学习跟踪模型最优解而非从零探索。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人运动与操作任务中，纯强化学习从零开始探索动态动作效率低、难度大，难以学习复杂且稳定的行为。


# 二、方法

> 提出在训练时用GPU批处理的质心模型预测控制（MPC）为每个环境并行求解最优规划（质心轨迹、动量、地面反作用力、落脚点及手部推力），并将该规划用于奖励塑形和critic指导，使策略学习跟踪模型最优解而非从零探索。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 摘要中未提供具体量化数字，但表明该方法能加速并扩展MPC引导的人形运动与操作强化学习，使用4096个并行环境训练。


# 四、对我的启发

> MPC引导可有效降低RL搜索难度，但依赖模型精度和求解实时性；该工作与机器人具身智能高度相关，可借鉴其训练期引导范式到其他操作任务中。
